description:
Music video for the song Genei, directed, animated, and musically written by Harumaki Gohan, featuring vocals by Hatsune Miku.

Note: There exists two versions of this song; the first being a vocaloid version featuring Hatsune Miku uploaded on March 30, 2022 and a self-cover version by Harumaki Gohan, which was uploaded later on April 13, 2022.
